checkpoints.description: [1/2] Accumulate the incumbent's stats across rungs

impact_assessment.benefits: Keep one score accumulator for the incumbent across rungs and finalize identical stats at each rung
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first equivalence test, exact big-tune decision A/B, full suite and strict gates; revert on any decision or accounting change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical stats, decisions and measure order; dependency: tune-measure helpers; concurrency: process-local counter; state: accumulator scoped to one sweep
impact_assessment.why: sweepCore re-scored the incumbent from scratch at each growing rung, re-looping the first items although their answers were cached

checkpoints.description: [2/2] VERIFIED: carried incumbent score across rungs; three 14-round big-tune A/Bs improved 1.06x, 1.15x and 1.165x with identical decisions every round; full npm suite 1343 pass 0 fail 1 skip; real three-model tune gate passed 9/9 rates with zero delta
